text:
samir: Heads-up: planning an APAC edge routing update tonight 23:00 UTC. Goal: rebalance weights from current 30% -> 70% on apac-edge-pool-A, lower Route53 TTL to 30s, and tighten health probe interval to 10s for faster failover. Who can own the deploy and run the smoke checks? @maya @kevin

maya: I can own the deploy and be on-call. Proposed cadence: canary -> 50% at 23:00, step to 70% at 23:10, and final to 100% at 23:25. Rollback plan: revert weight changes and restore TTL=300s; I'll post the rollback command in the channel if needed. Need PR + infra approvals before 22:30 UTC. Link to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/apac-routing (see section "quick rollback"). :white_check_mark:

kevin: SGTM. I'll prepare the traffic-shaping job and pre-run the health probe smoke harness. Script I'm going to run (local test):
```
# quick dry-run
routeshift --region apac --pool apac-edge-pool-A --from 30 --to 50 --mode canary --dry-run
curl -sS https://edge-apac.example.com/health | jq .status
```
Also going to warm KV caches on the APAC edges before cutover. PR: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4823 (branch: apac-routing/rollout-1794567890) — awaiting review.

dmitri: I'll own monitoring during the rollout. Watch items: latency p95 > 100ms, error rate > 0.5%, 5xx spike. I’ll attach temporary alert thresholds and keep an eye on downstream DB saturation. If any alert fires, I'll call for immediate rollback.

deploy-bot: Scheduled job created: canary-run apac-edge-pool-A @ 2026-03-17T23:00:00Z (id: canary-1794567890). Notifying ops channel.

maya: Smoke checklist (quick):
1) curl health on 3 representative edge IPs
2) run 10 sample user queries from APAC e2e harness
3) verify KV hit-rate > 80% within 5m
Commands:
```
curl -sf https://10.12.34.5/health || echo "edge down"
./e2e_harness --region apac --samples 10 --timeout 30
aws route53 get-change --id /change/C1234567890  # verify TTL applied
```
If smoke fails, we revert weights + TTL and post rollback note.

samir: Who runs the revert command if we need it? Maya? Or infra oncall? (we should pre-assign).

maya: I'll execute the revert if needed, unless infra asks to take it. I'll also keep my laptop open w/ ssh to the traffic controller during the steps.

kevin: FYI I added a small safety: if error rate > 0.7% for 5m during step, the routeshift job will auto-pause and open a ticket. See flag in the script: `--auto-pause-threshold 0.007`.

emma: Notifying product/metrics team: we'll hold feature flag expansion until you confirm 100% apac shift complete.

dmitri: Canary started at 23:00: canary id canary-1794567890. Initial checks: no 5xx increase, p95 up ~12ms. Continue to 70% at 23:10 if stable.

maya: 23:12 update: smoke passed (health curl OK on all samples, e2e samples returned expected tokens). Proceed to 100% at 23:25 unless objections. :thumbsup:

dmitri: Monitoring: small p95 increase but within SLO, infra metrics look healthy. No error alerts. Recommend proceed.

infra-bot: Route53 change applied: TTL=30s for apac-edge.example.com (change-id C987654321).

deploy-bot: Rollout completed: APAC traffic at 100% on apac-edge-pool-A at 2026-03-17T23:28:09Z. Change-id: canary-1794567890 -> final-1794567890.

maya: Done: docs and postmortem notes updated in the runbook page. Thanks everyone. I'll leave a short follow-up in #eng-platform tomorrow with any lingering observations.

samir: Great work — thanks team. Closing the loop. :tada:
